children: At InfoComm India 2026, the Titan Intech brand launched its Ultra Shield MiP display and introduced a wider portfolio covering video conferencing, audio, wireless collaboration, recording and streaming

UltraLED Displays, the professional LED display brand of BSE-listed Titan Intech, has expanded its proposition beyond display technology with the launch of its Ultra Shield MiP display and a new UltraLED AV Solutions portfolio at InfoComm India 2026 in Mumbai.

The launches took place on September 16, the opening day of the three-day Pro AV and integrated experience technology exhibition at Jio World Convention Centre. InfoComm India 2026 is being held from September 16 to 18 and brings together technology providers, system integrators, consultants and enterprise users across the professional audiovisual ecosystem.
UltraLED is participating in InfoComm India for the first time, showcasing its indoor, outdoor and customised LED display portfolio alongside the new solutions at Booth TH01 in Jasmine Hall.
Ultra Shield MiP Targets High-performance Environments

The centrepiece of the showcase is Ultra Shield MiP, a premium LED display based on Micro LED in Package (MiP) technology. The display is positioned for applications including corporate environments, control rooms, broadcast facilities, experience centres, luxury retail and premium public spaces.

The display is available in pixel pitches starting at 0.78mm, with the company citing a pixel density of up to 1.63 million pixels per square metre, a 7000:1 contrast ratio, brightness of up to 1000 nits and more than 97 per cent brightness and colour uniformity.

It also features a 170-degree viewing angle, 3840Hz refresh rate and 16-bit grayscale. UltraLED says its Common Cathode architecture can bring average power consumption down to 112W per square metre, while a fully front-access design is intended to simplify maintenance. The company also cites cabinet flatness of up to 0.1mm and an operational lifespan of up to 100,000 hours.

The launch comes as display technology forms an increasingly important part of the wider Pro AV ecosystem. InfoComm India's 2026 programme itself includes dedicated tracks covering display technologies, digital signage, live events and immersive technology, reflecting the convergence of visual communication with broader integrated experiences.
Alongside Ultra Shield MiP, UltraLED has introduced UltraLED AV Solutions, extending the brand into professional audiovisual and collaboration technologies.

The portfolio covers video conferencing, audio, wireless collaboration, recording and streaming, and boardroom and conference systems. The solutions are intended for environments including corporate offices, conference rooms, hybrid workspaces, training centres, educational institutions, government facilities, command and control centres, auditoriums and seminar halls.
The move broadens UltraLED's role from supplying visual display hardware to offering a wider set of technologies that support communication and collaboration.

Su Piow Ko, Director, Titan Intech, says, “Today marks an important milestone in UltraLED’s journey, and launching Ultra Shield MiP and UltraLED AV Solutions at InfoComm India makes this moment even more significant for us. As one of the leading platforms for the professional AV industry, InfoComm gives us the opportunity to present our latest innovations to the right ecosystem of technology leaders, customers, partners and industry stakeholders. With these launches, we are taking our proposition beyond displays to address the evolving communication and collaboration needs of organisations, and we believe this platform is the right stage to introduce this expanded vision for UltraLED.”

Kumarraju Rudraraju, Director, Titan Intech, adds, “Launching Ultra Shield MiP and UltraLED AV Solutions at InfoComm India is strategically very important for UltraLED and Titan Intech. The event brings together a strong cross-section of the professional AV ecosystem and provides us with an ideal platform to showcase our technology capabilities, engage with potential customers and partners, and build greater visibility for our expanding portfolio. Our entry into Professional AV represents an important step in strengthening UltraLED’s market proposition and creating new opportunities across enterprise, education, government and other professional environments.”
Building A Wider Pro AV Proposition

The expansion comes as India's Pro AV market continues to develop across enterprise, education, government, live events, hospitality, retail and other sectors. InfoComm India says its 2026 edition is expected to feature more than 300 global brands and over 14,000 industry professionals, with the exhibition spanning more than 10,600 square metres.

For UltraLED, the new portfolio builds on its existing LED display business and its focus on locally engineered display technologies. The brand is part of Titan Intech, which the company says has operated since 1984, and has been expanding its presence through experience centres and the Ultra NEXUS partner network.

The launch therefore marks a broader positioning shift for UltraLED — from a display-focused technology provider towards a Pro AV solutions brand spanning visual communication, collaboration and connected workplace technologies.
